archiveRetention.scope: Real host governance and transaction entry points in isolated test workspaces on Windows. Evidence I/O and concurrent writers/readers use the real filesystem. These are deterministic host tests.
tested: reclose and reopen retain exactly the archives reachable from current state and its rolling backup
repeated interrupted publications keep both authoritative roots, defer a live journal and refuse rival collection
an in-flight evidence reader finishes with its original exact bytes while two commits retire that revision
three closed proofs over the combined hot limit remain addressable with exact contents
forced exit after sidecar publication preserves old host state and permits idempotent retry
production ledger closes on both full reviews and after a restart revalidates the archived proof

interpretation.reopen: Two units are present. One remains unchanged while the other closes, reopens and closes again. At each of 15 commits the exact set of managed sidecars matched the union of the two on-disk indices. Counts include both units.
interpretation.hardExit: Exit 83 interrupts a fresh writer after publishing different immutable bytes and before changing either index. On three successive abrupt exits the count stayed at two authoritative objects plus one in-flight object. On restart it fell to the two referenced objects.
interpretation.reader: After the native file descriptor opened and passed the identity check, the reader paused at its first read. Another process committed two revisions. The reader then decoded its original proof string, 75,000 ASCII bytes. The next publication retained precisely the two referenced revisions.
interpretation.scopeLimit: Corrupt or unidentifiable blobs, foreign files and hard links are preserved for inspection. A journal or a live writer defers conflicting collection.

freshEngineering.exercise: 既有收银汇总代码修正与后续跨店变更
freshEngineering.method: 三个版本使用同一份封存源码、用户需求和 VM 评分器。在隔离目录恢复真实工程授权与签名基线，向执行方预送此角色真实生成的工程指令、prepare 和授权原文 read，模型通过实际注册的受控编辑工具落盘。第二轮只接各自上一轮物理文件，采用新授权执行会话；未测同会话缓存复用。编译和执行只发生在评分器的受限 VM。旧回归通过的基线和终稿均据实际运行签名。各阶段以源码独立复测通过作停止点，随后由受信运行器提交到宿主首审待办。没有运行自然双审与关单。两轮相加 25 个检查点，包括第二轮重跑的第一轮检查，单个模式一个样本。

tasks: 收银日报偶尔把重复导入的订单算了两次。按订单 ID 取序号最大的事件，同序号以后收到的为准；最后状态为 cancelled 的不计。修好现有汇总，调用方仍按原接口使用。
现在接入多家分店。不同店允许出现相同订单 ID，各店独立去重；没写 store 的历史事件归到 default 店。summary(events, store) 可以只看一家店，老的 summary(events) 继续汇总所有店。店名、订单 ID 均可为任意非空字符串。
task.interface: 输入事件有 id（非空字符串）、seq（非负整数）、cents（整数分）、state（paid 或 cancelled）。输入属于调用方，输出是 count 和 cents。
task.checkNote: Initial 7 behavior checks plus unmodified inputs; revision keeps 8 existing checks plus 7 new. Two existing files and export names form the contract; the active-order query is independently imported outside summary.

invalidExperiment.reason: 误用了只读 candidate.md 的文稿执行员提示，又要求模型以聊天 JSON 交付两个工程文件；没有提供其请求的可执行工具。模型答复不能产生可评的工程交付。六次调用均保留，无法据此评为 0/25。

limitations: 三组相同满分意味着这件小工程没有区分出实现能力差距。
各组模型请求次数、缓存和时间仅适用于这一次两阶段夹具。
宿主正常阻止用 write 覆盖已有代码，执行方可以带当前 SHA 改用 edit，全部工具退回和成功均列出。
对同一输入的排名、适应大工程能力、自然双审关单和实机运行性能均不能从此题推定。
